hints.title: First Number Prefix Choice
hints.text: The first number can be any non-empty prefix of s that leaves at least one character for the remainder.

hints.title: Strictly Decreasing Match Requirement
hints.text: Once the initial number val is chosen, the next substring must numerically equal val - 1.

hints.title: Recursive Prefix Verification
hints.text: Recursively search the remaining suffix for val - 1 until the entire string is consumed.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all partitions of s takes exponential time O(2^n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since each subsequent value is strictly determined by val - 1, each prefix choice traces a unique linear path.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate parses prefix numbers and verifies successive segments decrease by exactly 1.
